title: RadioButton / RadioGroup
description: Fiori radio buttons in a group with roving tabindex; arrow keys move selection, value and read-only states.

usage.summary: Choose one mutually exclusive answer while keeping every option visible.
useWhen: Let users compare visible answers and select exactly one.
Keep option labels clear enough to distinguish the mutually exclusive choices.
Provide an accessible group name and a label for every RadioGroupItem.

avoidWhen.when: Select independent options or multiple answers.
Collapse a predefined list of 2–12 options instead of showing every answer; sort alphabetically above 8.
Switch compact related view or setting options rather than answer a form question.
Run an explicit action rather than select an answer.
Adjust a numeric value along a visual scale rather than choose categorical options.
